pr.body:
## Summary
Production-readiness swarm over the SceneAxi gap list (docs/audits/production-swarm/): 12-lane audit + build + finishing pass + visual-improvement loop.

- **authoring** — out-of-root write refusals, seed validation, portable migration journal
- **engine** — replay determinism, framebuffer/snapshot validation, transactional advance, context release, budgets, local audio, texture/playback/gamepad proofs
- **importers/plugins** — iterative deep-graph traversal, plugin byte-binding, symlink containment
- **billing/credits** — migration 0008 chain validation, hosted reservation SQL, ledger corruption guards, PG17 restore oracle
- **identity/sites** — export/disable/recovery contracts, browser origin tests, editor persistence, canonical metadata, restrictive CSP, catalog search/filter/sort, durable quarantine intake
- **desktop** — readiness fix, CSP/IPC hardening, smokes, default-off Windows CI job
- **ops** — workflow SHA pinning, Kids isolated build job, TypeDoc fixes, lock bumps within pins
- **visual** — typography/spacing/contrast/mobile improvements across umbrella, catalogs, Kids, desktop chrome (finish-visual-* reports, 90+ before/after screenshots)

## Verification
- pnpm gate: **294 files / 4,513 tests + 40 Node contracts**
- pnpm test:golden: **57 files / 544 tests**
- SDK 163 entries; four site production builds; browser + provider suites green

## Known residuals
- Padded-8MiB GUI reload stall (open defect)
- sharp advisories blocked by Next pin (documented triage)
- Native per-project build certification external (signing hosts)
- Optional lint:anti-slop red on main (~25k findings); touched-file cleanup continuing on this branch
- External launch inputs in docs/audits/production-swarm/FINAL.json

Verification: pnpm gate 294 files / 4513 tests + 40 Node contracts; test:golden 57/544; SDK 163 entries; four site builds; browser/provider suites green.
Linter note: repository-required gate green; optional lint:anti-slop red on main (~25k findings) — touched-file cleanup continuing on this branch. anti-slop/no-runtime-typeof enables its documented allowInTypeGuards option.
Residuals: padded-8MiB GUI reload stall (open defect); sharp advisories blocked by Next pin; native per-project build certification external.
